name: anim_jyu_slam_lean
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: He springs up from the crouch, straightening his legs and throwing his upper body far back, pushing his chest and big belly forward, arms pulled back. The face keeps the same thick angular eyebrows, half-lidded eyes and closed mouth. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
